headline: Dolphins not optimistic about De'Von Achane's knee injury
summary: The star running back was injured on the team's first possession.

headline: Commanders snap Seattle's 12-game winning streak, beat the Seahawks 33-31
summary: — Marcus Mariota threw three touchdown passes, and Kain Medrano returned an interception 50 yards for a touchdown to help the Washington Commanders hand Seattle its first loss since November, 33-31 on Sunday.

headline: Commanders' Leo Chenal carted off on stretcher with neck injury
summary: Commanders linebacker Leo Chenal suffered a potentially serious neck injury today against the Seahawks.

headline: Justin Jefferson is questionable to return with an ankle injury
summary: The Vikings have quarterback Kyler Murray back in the lineup, but they may have lost their top wide receiver for the rest of the day.

headline: Brian Burns to have MRI on knee
summary: Giants defensive end Brian Burns was expected to miss Sunday's game against the Titans with an ankle injury, but he was able to play long enough to suffer another injury.
